title: 3rd-grade students at Meadowvale Elementary reach 98.1% participation in 2024-25 reading MCA
text:
3rd-grade students at Meadowvale Elementary reach 98.1% participation in 2024-25 reading MCA
G. M. Kenyon
The Minnesota Department of Education reports that Meadowvale Elementary School third-graders posted the third highest participation rate on the reading section of the 2024-25 MCA.
Among the 291 students who completed this portion of the test at Meadowvale Elementary School, 101 were third-graders.
Based on test standards, 71% of third-grade students were identified as proficient in reading.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state-administered tests designed to assess student progress relative to Minnesota’s academic standards. These assessments evaluate math, reading, and science in specific grade levels. The majority of students participate in the MCA, while eligible students receiving special education services may complete the Alt MCA instead.
According to Minnesota's Report Card, overall proficiency rates on Minnesota’s MCA exams have decreased since before the pandemic. Since 2019, math proficiency dropped by more than 7%, and reading proficiency declined by nearly 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in reading |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 101 | 71% |
| 4th | 103 | 67% |
| 5th | 87 | 71% |
Information in this article was obtained from the Minnesota Department of Education. The source data can be found here.
